# Raleigh public HTML fixtures

Captured from the publisher URLs in manifest.json during November 6–7, 2026.
Only allowed normal HTML pages were fetched for these fixtures. No JSON or ICS
export URL is an ingestion endpoint for this batch.

Squarespace fixtures retain the actual upcoming calendar cards and the audited
collection ID/path/public permission/timezone subset of Static.SQUARESPACE_CONTEXT.
IndieCommerce fixtures retain the actual calendar view, pagination/next-month
links or event article, canonical URL and embedded event JSON-LD. Unrelated page
chrome, active scripts, style blocks and redundant attributes were removed.
Embedded JSON-LD venue fields on the bookstore pages are malformed; visible
HTML event addresses remain authoritative. Hashes cover these reduced fixtures.

Replay clock: 2026-11-07T00:00:00Z. Seven sources produce 83 candidates with 83
original image candidates. This is a local parser replay, not transport proof,
a staging count or public publication count. Black Chamber's sole upcoming
calendar card lacks an address. Its flyer names The Fresh Collective, while
https://blackchamberraleigh.com/bcr-gala names 1200 S State St and an earlier
end time; leave the source held for same-event review. Two Triangle Pop-Up
holiday cards contradict their explicit Event Times narratives and are held.
Incomplete event venues are held individually without source-center pins.
